next_action.rationale: Determine carrier-side state of EXC-0921 orders. Specifically: (1) Have these orders been transmitted to carrier systems? (2) What state are they in (booked, rejected, pending)? (3) Is there a known limitation with split-reservation bookings? (4) Are east-node carrier lanes operational? This will discriminate between allocation_rule_defect (carrier can't process split-reservations), carrier_feed_lag (orders not transmitted or confirmation stalled), and dock_capacity (carrier operational but node-level constraint).
next_action.expected_information_gain: Determines whether the failure point is in order transmission, carrier booking acceptance, or pickup confirmation flow
